apps.name: PocketDocs
apps.summary: A personal, fully offline digital locker for your Driving Licence, RC, Pollution Certificate, Insurance, Aadhaar, PAN, Passport and more. Scan, organize, share and get renewal reminders, with nothing ever uploaded to a server.

features.title: Scan like a pro scanner
features.text: Capture both sides of any document, drag the corners to crop, and clean it up with Grayscale, B&W or Enhanced filters.

features.title: Organized your way
features.text: Browse by category with quick filter chips, add custom categories, and group related documents, like a “Car” pile for RC, Insurance & PUC.

features.title: Never miss a renewal
features.text: Set an expiry date on any document and get a reminder from your own phone before it lapses.

features.title: Share in one tap
features.text: Send any document as images or a combined PDF to WhatsApp, email, Drive or anywhere else.

features.title: App Lock
features.text: Protected by the fingerprint, face unlock, PIN or pattern you already use. No new password to remember.

features.title: Document to Text
features.text: Extract English text from any scan or photo, fully offline, then copy or share it instantly.

features.title: Import existing files
features.text: Already have a photo or PDF? Import it directly instead of scanning again.

features.title: Your language, your theme
features.text: Use it in English, हिंदी or తెలుగు, with Light, Dark or System theme.

privacy.title: Your privacy, by design
privacy.text: PocketDocs was built offline-first from the ground up. Your documents stay exactly where you put them, on your phone.

screenshots.caption: All your documents in one place
